name: Synap by Linkrra
description: Synap by Linkrra model provider: open models on dedicated GPUs behind an OpenAI-compatible API, live model list and prices. Pay with an API key, or per call in USDC over x402 (Base or Solana) through a local proxy.

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Open models on dedicated GPUs; or pay per call in USDC with no key

mode.description: auto (default): use an API key when one is configured, else pay per call from a wallet over x402. api-key: key only. x402: wallet only.

walletKey.description: EVM private key (0x + 64 hex) that pays in USDC on Base. Precedence: this, then SYNAP_WALLET_KEY, then ~/.synap/wallet.key.

solanaKey.description: Solana secret key (base58 or 64-byte JSON array) that pays in USDC on Solana. Precedence: this, then SYNAP_SOLANA_KEY, then ~/.synap/solana.key.

preferNetwork.description: Which chain to pay on when both wallets are set (default base).

maxPerCallUsd.description: Per-call ceiling in USD for wallet payments, checked before anything is signed (default 0.10).

maxTotalUsd.description: Optional spend budget in USD for wallet payments per gateway run. Unset means no total cap.

port.description: Loopback port of the local x402 proxy (default 8419).

walletKey.label: Base wallet key
walletKey.placeholder: 0x... (optional; pays per call in USDC on Base)
